I will keep my land mainly in the wheat-maize system, because that is what fits my fields, my well irrigation, and my years of experience. Since some people in my family work off-farm, I do not want a plan that is too scattered or too labor-heavy. I will put 8.4 mu into winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land, because that gives me steady grain output and uses the land fully through the year. I will keep 4.0 mu in cotton, because cotton still gives me cash income, but I will not expand it too much since it needs more spraying and more hand work. I will use better seed, give enough fertilizer to support yield, irrigate when the crop is most sensitive, and keep pesticide use at a level I can manage without overspending. I will use rotary tillage for wheat, no-tillage for summer maize after wheat to save time, and plough for cotton so the soil is looser at the start.
